records.title: Optimizing Decoding Paths in Masked Diffusion Models by Quantifying Uncertainty
records.reason: 主題は学習エージェント/安全/ドメイン固有応用などで、LLM推論の計算量・メモリ・遅延・スループット・量子化・serving改善に具体的に結び付かない。

records.title: Group Representational Position Encoding
records.reason: A transformer positional-encoding design with streaming/cache rules is relevant to long-context architecture, but no measured serving-efficiency gain is reported.

records.title: TWEO: Transformers Without Extreme Outliers Enables FP8 Training And Quantization For Dummies
records.reason: Low-precision quantization is adjacent to LLM deployment, but this paper evaluates training/quantization behavior without a concrete LLM serving gain.

records.title: FDSRM: A Feature-Driven Style-Agnostic Foundation Model for Sketch-Less Facial Image Retrieval
records.reason: Primary publisher full text could not be retrieved; available metadata concerns sketch-less facial retrieval, so relevance to MoE/LLM inference remains unresolved.

records.title: Transformer++: a long sequence modeling method based on direction-aware dual attention and multi-head sampling
records.reason: Publisher page exposed abstract only; it claims faster long-sequence transformer inference but full text and reproducible evidence were unavailable.
